```{r}
combined_augmented_data = read.csv("combined_augmented_data.csv")
combined_augmented_data = combined_augmented_data %>% select(-cAb13)
# Retain variant value, replace replicate value with a rowname column to identify
# each sample. Color the final heatmap by the variant value and store prediction history
# alongisde rowname
labled_augmented_data = combined_augmented_data %>% select(-Replicate) %>% 
  mutate("SampleNum" = row.names(combined_augmented_data), .before = Conc.)
```

```{r}
augmented_modeling_function = function(dataset,
                                       target,
                                       k_folds,
                                       model_type,
                                       lower_thresh = 0,
                                       upper_thresh = 251){
  
  dataset = dataset %>% filter(Conc. > lower_thresh & Conc. < upper_thresh)
  concentrations = dataset$Conc.
  
  gen_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = dataset) %>% 
    update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') %>% 
    # step_BoxCox(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  folds = vfold_cv(dataset, v=10, repeats = 2, strata = target_vector)
  
  if (model_type == 'rbf_svm'){
    mod = svm_rbf(cost = tune(), rbf_sigma = tune()) %>% 
    set_mode('classification') %>% 
    set_engine('kernlab')
  }
  
  if (model_type == 'rf'){
    mod = rand_forest(trees = 5000, mtry = tune(), min_n = tune()) %>% 
      set_mode('classification') %>% 
      set_engine('ranger')
    
    extract_parameter_set_dials(mod) %>% 
      finalize(dataset)
  }
  
  resample_results = mod %>% 
    tune_grid(
      gen_rec,
      resamples = folds,
      control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
    )
  
  metrics = collect_metrics(resample_results)
  print(metrics)
  return(list("resample_results" = resample_results,
              "concentrations" = concentrations))
}

model_results = augmented_modeling_function(labled_augmented_data,
                            'target_vector',
                            k_folds = 5,
                            model_type = 'rf',
                            lower_thresh = 0.9,
                            upper_thresh = 249)

collect_predictions(model_results$resample_results)
show_best(model_results$resample_results)
show_best(model_results$resample_results, metric = "accuracy")

unique(collect_predictions(model_results$resample_results)$.pred_class)
# This is super weird, the class probabilities don't seem to be related to the predicted class,
# meaning that the class with the max probability does not correspond to the predicted class provided.
# If I just take the max probability value and assign class based on that, do we get a different accuracy value?
# It seems like we do - the value differ by quite a bit actually which I can't rationalize because in the case
# of both RFs and SVMs, the indicated probabilities are likely just the number of classifiers that predict the
# given class
best_params = show_best(model_results$resample_results)
best_params
# RBF_SVM
best_cost = best_params$cost[[1]]
best_sigma = best_params$rbf_sigma[[1]]

best_param_preds = collect_predictions(model_results$resample_results, parameters = best_params[1,]) # %>% 
  # filter(cost == best_cost & rbf_sigma == best_sigma)

# RANDOM FOREST
best_mtry = best_params$mtry[[1]]
best_min_n = best_params$min_n[[1]]

best_param_preds = collect_predictions(model_results$resample_results) %>% 
  filter(mtry == best_mtry & min_n == best_min_n)

# SAME FOR ALL
best_param_probs = data.frame('Beta' = best_param_preds$.pred_Beta,
                              'Delta' = best_param_preds$.pred_Delta,
                              'Omicron' = best_param_preds$.pred_Omicron,
                              'WT' = best_param_preds$.pred_WT)

# Function to call with apply to identify the difference between the largest and second largest value
# difference increase as concetration increases
max_diff = function(x){
  vec = sort(unlist(x, use.names = F), decreasing = T)
  diff = vec[1]-vec[2]
  return(diff)
}
best_param_probs$max_diff = apply(best_param_probs, 1, max_diff)
best_param_probs$max_prob = apply(best_param_probs, 1, function(x) paste0(names(best_param_probs)[x==max(x)]))
best_param_probs$true_class = best_param_preds$target_vector
best_param_probs$correct = ifelse(best_param_probs$max_prob == best_param_probs$true_class, 1, 0)
best_param_probs$concentration = model_results$concentrations

# Plot the difference in probability for correct predictions vs incorrect predictions, face_wrapped by true variant
sum(best_param_probs$max_prob == best_param_preds$target_vector)/nrow(best_param_probs)

# Now I could see what the average difference is in probability between the max probability value and the second highest value. Ideally, i would see this
# increase as a function of increasing concentration
# Concentration values are obtained from the modeled dataset after concentration bounds
best_param_probs %>% filter(correct == 1) %>% reframe(mean = mean(max_diff),
                                                      median = median(max_diff),
                                                      sd = sd(max_diff))
best_param_probs %>% filter(correct == 0) %>% reframe(mean = mean(max_diff),
                                                      median = median(max_diff),
                                                      sd = sd(max_diff))

best_param_preds
```

```{r}
# Augmented modeling function with bayesian optimization + Xgboost results
augmented_xgb_modeling_function = function(dataset,
                                       target,
                                       k_folds,
                                       lower_thresh = 0,
                                       upper_thresh = 251){
  
  dataset = dataset %>% filter(Conc. > lower_thresh & Conc. < upper_thresh)
  concentrations = dataset$Conc.
  
  gen_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = dataset) %>% 
    update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') %>% 
    # step_BoxCox(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  folds = vfold_cv(dataset, v=10, repeats = 1, strata = target_vector)
  
  xgb_model = boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    min_n = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune()
  ) %>% 
    set_mode('classification') %>% 
    set_engine("xgboost", nthread = 6)
  
  xgb_workflow = workflow() %>% add_recipe(gen_rec) %>% add_model(xgb_model)
  
  xgb_params = parameters(
    trees(), learn_rate(),
    tree_depth(), min_n(),
    loss_reduction(),
    sample_size = sample_prop(), finalize(mtry(), dataset)
  )
  
  xgb_params = xgb_params %>% update(trees = trees(c(250, 500)))
  
  xgb_resample = xgb_workflow %>% 
    tune_bayes(
      resamples = folds,
      param_info = xgb_params,
      iter = 30,
      metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc),
      control = control_bayes(no_improve = 10,
                              save_pred = T)
    )
  
  metrics = collect_metrics(xgb_resample)
  print(metrics)
  return(list("resample_results" = xgb_resample,
              "concentrations" = concentrations))
}

# Function to call with apply to identify the difference between the largest and second largest value
# difference increase as concetration increases
max_diff = function(x){
  vec = sort(unlist(x, use.names = F), decreasing = T)
  diff = vec[1]-vec[2]

}
best_xgb_param_probs$max_diff = apply(best_xgb_param_probs, 1, max_diff)
best_xgb_param_probs$max_prob = apply(best_xgb_param_probs, 1, function(x) paste0(names(best_xgb_param_probs)[x==max(x)]))
best_xgb_param_probs$true_class = xgb_predictions$target_vector
best_xgb_param_probs$correct = ifelse(best_xgb_param_probs$max_prob == best_xgb_param_probs$true_class, 1, 0)
best_xgb_param_probs$concentration = xgb_model_results$concentrations[xgb_predictions$.row]

# Plot the difference in probability for correct predictions vs incorrect predictions, face_wrapped by true variant
sum(best_xgb_param_probs$max_prob == xgb_predictions$target_vector)/nrow(best_xgb_param_probs)

show_best(xgb_model_results$resample_result)

show_best(xgb_model_results$resample_result, metric = "roc_auc")
best_xgb_param_probs %>% filter(correct == 1) %>% reframe(mean = mean(max_diff),

# So if we say that mean 
high_confidence_predictions = best_xgb_param_probs %>% filter(max_diff > mean(max_diff))
low_confidence_predictions = best_xgb_param_probs %>% filter(max_diff < mean(max_diff))
sum(high_confidence_predictions$correct)/nrow(high_confidence_predictions)
sum(low_confidence_predictions$correct)/nrow(low_confidence_predictions)

ggplot(data = high_confidence_predictions, aes(x=concentration))+
  geom_histogram()

ggplot(data = low_confidence_predictions, aes(x=concentration))+
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r}
two_step_xgb_tune = function(dataset,
                             upper_thresh = 251,
                             lower_thresh = 0.1){
  
  dataset = dataset %>% filter(Conc. > lower_thresh & Conc. < upper_thresh)
  concentrations = dataset$Conc.
  
  gen_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = dataset) %>% 
    update_role(SampleNum, Conc., new_role = 'id') %>% 
    step_YeoJohnson(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  xgb_folds = vfold_cv(dataset, v=10, repeats = 1, strata = target_vector)
  
  xgb_mod_stage1 = boost_tree(
    mode = "classification",
    engine = "xgboost",
    learn_rate = tune()
  )
  
  grid_stage_1 = grid_random(
    learn_rate(),
    size= 20
  )
  
  xgb_stage1_wf = workflow() %>% 
    add_model(xgb_mod_stage1) %>% 
    add_recipe(gen_rec)
  
  xgb_tune_stage_1 = tune_grid(
    xgb_stage1_wf,
    resamples = xgb_folds,
    grid = grid_stage_1,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy),
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )
  print(xgb_tune_stage_1)

  best_params_stage_1 = xgb_tune_stage_1 %>% 
    collect_metrics() %>% 
    arrange(-mean) %>% 
    slice_head(n=1)
  
  xgb_mod_stage2 = xgb_mod_stage1 %>% 
    set_args(
      learn_rate = best_params_stage_1$learn_rate,
      tree_depth = tune(),
      loss_reduction = tune(),
      stop_iter = tune()
    )
  
  xgb_tune_stage_2 = xgb_stage1_wf %>% 
    update_model(xgb_mod_stage2)
  
  # Define stage 2 grid
  grid_stage_2 = grid_random(
    tree_depth(),
    loss_reduction(),
    stop_iter(),
    size = 20
  )
  
  tune_stage_2 = tune_grid(
    xgb_tune_stage_2,
    resamples = xgb_folds,
    grid = grid_stage_2,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy),
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )
  
  metrics = collect_metrics(tune_stage_2)
  print(metrics)
  return(list("resample_results" = tune_stage_2,
              "concentrations" = concentrations))
}
```
